title: Research Package Synthesis
description: Structured output of the research-package-synthesis LLM call — the JSONB stored in research_packages.synthesis. Narrative/analytical fields only: claim and source listings are never duplicated here — they are assembled live from the relational tables by get_current_research_package() at read time, so there is exactly one source of truth. `cited_source_ids` must list every source_id referenced anywhere in this document; build_research_package() rejects the package (CITATION_INTEGRITY_FAILED) if any id is not a real source_id for this project. See docs/architecture/research-pipeline.md#research-package.

chronology.description: Timeline entries, only where the topic is reasonably chronological — empty array otherwise.

prohibited_unsafe_assertions.description: Assertions the collected research does NOT support and the future script must not make.

cited_source_ids.description: Union of every source_id cited anywhere in this document (important_statistics[].source_ids, chronology[].source_ids, and any inline citation elsewhere). Checked against `sources` by validate_research_package_citations() — never trusted as-is.
